label: Garland AggregatorTAP Fiber SMF 1G/10G (P10GSSA-5)
description: Garland AggregatorTAP: Fiber P10GSSA-5 - portable passive fibre TAP for single-mode: two LC network ports carrying 1G-LX/10G-LR through unpowered, copies delivered on two SFP+ cages at 1G/10G, switch-selectable aggregation, breakout and regeneration/SPAN modes, jumbo frames, four per 1U shelf.
notes: The datasheet's model table is the source of the split: the **network** side is fixed SMF 1G-LX/10G-LR **LC** fibre and the **monitor** side is **two SFP+ cages at 1G/10G** - different connectors on the two sides of one box, which is the whole point of the part (it converts the media as it copies). Modes (aggregation, breakout, regeneration/SPAN) are switches on the back, so this stays a passive TAP with no capabilities and no IP: A and B live ports pass traffic whether or not the TAP has power. Split ratios are 50/50 by default with 60/40, 80/20 and 90/10 available to order, so the spec models the standard even split.
